There are several large buildings in the distance, including a tall skyscraper on the left and a shorter building with a blue awning on the right. People are walking in both directions, some carrying bags or backpacks. A woman in a plaid shirt walks towards the camera while others stand still or walk away. The ground is made of gray bricks and has a few benches and trash cans along the way. The overall atmosphere is lively but somewhat gloomy due to the cloudy sky.
